set -eu

cat > /usr/local/sbin/zram-swap <<'ANTRIEB_ZRAM_SCRIPT'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu

STATE_FILE=/run/zram-swap.device

case "${1:-}" in
  start)
    if [ -r "$STATE_FILE" ]; then
      DEVICE=$(cat "$STATE_FILE")
      if swapon --show=NAME --noheadings | grep -Fxq "$DEVICE"; then
        exit 0
      fi
    fi

    /usr/sbin/modprobe zram
    DEVICE=$(/usr/sbin/zramctl --find --size 512M)
    /usr/sbin/mkswap "$DEVICE"
    /usr/sbin/swapon --priority 32767 "$DEVICE"
    printf '%s\n' "$DEVICE" > "$STATE_FILE"
    ;;
  stop)
    if [ -r "$STATE_FILE" ]; then
      DEVICE=$(cat "$STATE_FILE")
      /usr/sbin/swapoff "$DEVICE" 2>/dev/null || true
      /usr/sbin/zramctl --reset "$DEVICE" 2>/dev/null || true
      rm -f "$STATE_FILE"
    fi
    ;;
  *)
    printf 'Usage: %s {start|stop}\n' "$0" >&2
    exit 2
    ;;
esac
ANTRIEB_ZRAM_SCRIPT
chmod 0755 /usr/local/sbin/zram-swap
restorecon -F /usr/local/sbin/zram-swap
